attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Reworks core reference-counting/disposal logic for the shared LocalLock semaphore cache (used across background tasks and tenants) with subtle concurrency semantics (refcounting, dispose-only-if-unreferenced, new null/disposed checks) that, if a race is mis-handled, could cause deadlocks or ObjectDisposedException across the whole app despite added unit tests."}

reason: Reworks core reference-counting/disposal logic for the shared LocalLock semaphore cache (used across background tasks and tenants) with subtle concurrency semantics (refcounting, dispose-only-if-unreferenced, new null/disposed checks) that, if a race is mis-handled, could cause deadlocks or ObjectDisposedException across the whole app despite added unit tests.
